report: BLINDED SHADOW review of PR #2047 (issue #2039): an all-markdown, engine-self-modifying prose change consolidating /prflow:implement Phase 2's timing-insensitive workpad writes (per-step --tick-plan ticks and --status Planning/Implementing flips) onto the durability-checkpoint boundaries, plus a §2.0 resume-arm repair (tick already-present un-ticked Plan steps rather than re-implement). Phase 0.5 engine_self_modifying=true; type-design-analyzer and pr-test-analyzer gate OFF (no code/types/tests). All four always-on reviewers dispatched and returned real assessments. Independent AC verification: AC1-5,8 satisfied in the amended prose and mirrors; AC6 verified (scripts/workpad.py and scripts/phase2-durability-checkpoint.sh untouched, 'resume-kind: in-flight' still present, consolidated sites retain outcome-line/remedy direction); AC7 verified (summed byte delta +1414 <= 1500; lint-reference-size.py exits 0). The load-bearing safety claim that scripts/workpad.py maps Discovering/Planning/Implementing to one Progress phase was independently confirmed (_STATUS_TO_PROGRESS_PHASE -> Implement). No Critical/High/Medium findings. Findings are Low/Suggestion severity: a changeset trailer citing (#2047) where every other reference cites issue #2039, and the non-authoritative OVERVIEW/changeset mirror omitting the third accruing class (post-hoc evidence/sweep-result notes) named by the authoritative §2.0.5. Both are non-blocking prose nits. Shadow verdict: APPROVE.

phase3_findings.description: Changeset .changeset/issue-2039-consolidate-phase-2-workpad-writes.md trailer cites (#2047) while file name, both internal-doc mirrors, and commit subject cite issue #2039; bare (#2047) matches neither the issue nor the convention (issue #NNNN / PR #NNNN). Reconcile.

docs/internal/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §7 Phase 2 row enumerates the accruing set as only --tick-plan ticks and Planning/Implementing flips, omitting the third accruing class the authoritative §2.0.5 names (post-hoc evidence / sweep-result notes). Non-authoritative summary, so not a contradiction; add the third class or a non-exhaustive hedge.

Accruing-set mirror incompleteness: both DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §7 and the changeset omit the 'post-hoc evidence notes (sweep results)' accruing category present in authoritative §2.0.5; a reader treating either mirror as the accruing set would misclassify sweep-result notes as immediate.

Potential sweep-note classification ambiguity: §2.0.5 places 'sweep-selection' notes in the immediate set and 'post-hoc evidence notes (sweep results)' in the accruing set; an agent must distinguish them. Mitigated by the explicit safe default ('one you cannot so classify is delivered immediately'), so mis-classification only reduces consolidation, never loses data.

Compaction-lost accrued NOTE (sweep-result evidence) is the one non-re-derivable accruable; the prose discloses it explicitly ('an accrued note so lost is accepted like crash loss') rather than dropping it silently, and every timing-sensitive record keeps its immediate call site. No silent-failure defect; disclosed and bounded.
